decisions: Scored grid is equilateral triangular. Two-way is reported and re-optimised beside it.
Scored members are arcs. Straight chords are unscored.
Perry a0=s/1000 is an extra scored mode.
Design k=0.2. Also re-optimised: k=1, k=0.4, k=0.5.
Joints are 5 percent of tube mass. 6061 is repeated with joints off.
SiC primary allowable is 3900 MPa. A 380 MPa flexural scan is separate.

pump.location: PDF page 6, SV 220 B and SV 300 B, 50 Hz
pump.facts: SV220B: 180 kg, 180 m3/h, maximum motor 4.5 kW. SV300B: 223 kg, 240 m3/h, maximum motor 5.5 kW. Both masses include oil. A rated speed is not a guaranteed installed speed at the hull.

film.location: PDF page 1, AF 163-2U weights; honeycomb tests later in sheet
film.facts: 0.015 and 0.030 lb/ft2 films exist. The lighter grade is only an optimistic mass option; the source does not qualify these Be/honeycomb joints.

air.facts: Moist-air density contains p/T and a water-vapour molecular-mass correction. This card uses its ideal-mixture limit, not the full CIPM metrology equation outside its temperature range.

getter.facts: The manufacturer offers room-temperature nitrogen sorption, including Combogetter. The predecessor's claim that getters only handle hydrogen/water is false. No capacity or full-scale lifetime is supplied here.

getter_hybrid.facts: NEXTorr combines NEG and ion pumping for active and noble gases/methane. This is not a qualified rough-vacuum air-leak pump for the sphere.

be_forms.facts: S200F is listed as VHP rod/bar/block, not rolled sheet. The table lists 290 GPa for S200F and 303 GPa for S200FH. No multi-metre thin curved S200F panel is established by this catalog. Tensile values do not replace the pinned compressive value.

core.facts: 5056 1/4-1.6 nominal honeycomb row; W shear is the lower-direction modulus. The pinned 014b conversions are retained.

seam.source: MAINLINE-016 INPUTS.json and CARD.md, pinned above; this card's explicit two-face splice geometry
seam.facts: 60/120 mm strips, 0.2/0.3 mm adhesive, 1.5/3 mm core splice, adhesive/paste densities 1250/1100 kg/m3 are owner assumptions, not qualified seam designs.

additional_sources.note: Opened primary PDF: 5056 3/8-1.0 row p5, dimensions p2; tests at 0.625 inch core depth.

Primary PDF opened through the manufacturer's link; p3 gives 0.059 inch and thicker stock maximum 24x72 inches, with narrower/shorter thin sheet. Its 0.059 inch (0.5mm) parenthesis is inconsistent; use the inch threshold 1.4986mm.
021 pinned source: historical SR200 lot, 379.2 MPa and conservative in-plane E293.6GPa; not a current design allowable.
Opened primary source: typical seal tubes 12 inch long, 3900MPa compression, 380MPa four-point bending; large curved thin tubes unestablished.
Opened primary PDF: brittle material cannot relieve tensile stress by metal-like yielding; source modulus430GPa versus retained011b410GPa.

decisions: Each family is optimized on its own exactly closed mass line; no common margin is imposed across different core geometries.
Main safety factors include high external pressure, retain no internal-pressure structural relief, and add 020's net-section joint screen.
Budget optimism and 021 mechanical optimism are separate axes, explicitly labelled.
No coating, mooring or propulsion mass is invented; zero extra coatings is a scope choice with quantified sensitivity and NFI.
The original 021 report has superseded artifact hashes; only revision 1 is accepted.
The 027 brief misspells the 019 report ID; verified actual filing is rpt-ref-d7f99cd71e977826da48.
